name: shopify-quiz-builder
description: An intuitive, no-code quiz builder for Shopify merchants

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:storefront"
scripts.build: npm run build:admin && npm run build:api && npm run build:storefront
scripts.test: npm run test:admin && npm run test:api && npm run test:storefront
scripts.lint: npm run lint:admin && npm run lint:api && npm run lint:storefront
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix:admin && npm run lint:fix:api && npm run lint:fix:storefront
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run docker:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.clean: npm run docker:clean && rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check:admin && npm run type-check:api && npm run type-check:storefront
scripts.test:cov: npm run test:cov:admin && npm run test:cov:api && npm run test:cov:storefront
scripts.bundle:analyze: npm run bundle:analyze:admin && npm run bundle:analyze:storefront
scripts.bundle:analyze:admin: cd apps/admin && npm run build && npm run analyze
scripts.bundle:analyze:storefront: cd apps/storefront && npm run build && npm run analyze

author: Shopify Quiz Builder Team
